title: RecurringScheduleModel
description: A recurring schedule defines an interval that can trigger tasks

active.description: Whether or not the schedule is active

duration.description: How long is the iteration of this schedule.  A weekly schedule with an iteration of 2 would restart every other week.

durationStartDate.description: When does the schedule iteration begin

scheduleConstraints.description: These indicate the rules for when a schedule should recur.  If all of the constraints are met then the schedule will trigger.

timeZoneId.description: Time Zone of the times the schedule is run

RecurringScheduleEntityModel.description: These are entities that subcribe to this schedule

entityId.description: The ID of the entity that is subscribing to this schedule

id.description: The id of schedule entity map

RecurringScheduleEntityType.description: This is the type of entity

RecurringScheduleType.description: The iteration period for the schedule.  The schedule will restart after this cycle.

RecurringScheduleValueModel.description: A defined constraint for a schedule

recurrenceValue.description: The value that applies to the constraint.
